maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from renting its own compressor fleet to oil and gas producers, plus some compressor sales; servicing is secondary.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private oil and natural gas producers who rent compressors; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by building and renting its own compressor fleet, not through a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Rental compressors keep wells producing; switching means downtime, reinstallation and re-optimization at wellsites, though rental alternatives exist.

notes: Split between rental and maintenance revenue is inferred from the website text, not stated.
